The only screen needed is a CODEGEN screen: nvcc EXIT-0 for SG_MB_TC_PROFILE={0,1} and PROVE byte-identical PTX/.so when OFF (the macros are no-ops, the workspace prof-buffer term is #if-gated) — mirror the decoder/vit OFF-byte-identical standard. fp64+A/A/A gate: NOT a parity-bearing change when OFF (transport-only-byte-identical); run the standard mamba fp64 oracle + A/A/A on the OFF build to confirm zero drift vs the current shipping .so (this is a no-op confirmation, not a re-anchor). ranked.title: RE-PROFILE the decoder per-phase split at the current 618ms PIPE=1/STAGES=4 build (the 19.2% B1 + 56.5% fwd/dX shares are STALE — measured at the superseded 920ms build) — a gate-free diagnostic that re-grounds the entire decoder relevance gate

Shrinking P1 by 1.49x changes BOTH B1's relative share AND its absolute slowest-minus-fastest-CTA delta (B1 wait is coupled to P1 tile-time variance, which the deeper ring perturbs). The campaign's relevance gate (projected delta = phase_share x phase_delta) CANNOT be honestly applied to ANY decoder lever (TILE_M, P1-epilogue, wgmma-pipeline) without this. Action: run the existing coarse 5-slot g_dec_prof_max (fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh:838-879; slot[2]=B1 at :877-879) + the --fwd-fine sub-profiler (the KEEPER byte-identical diagnostic, Ledger:118) at the 618ms build, both already wired.

Deliverable = the current-build phase table: `python tuning/decoder_bench.py --profile --d 2048 --B 16384` for the coarse 5-slot split, plus `--fwd-fine` for the in-ring WAIT/WGMMA/ISSUE/EPI/BARRIER sub-buckets. ranked.projected_step_delta: 0 (diagnostic). De-risks every downstream decoder lever: it tells the ratchet whether B1 is still ~19% (worth a real TILE_M cycle) or has fallen below the relevance floor post-1.49x, and whether the fwd/dX residual (the P1-epilogue target) grew or shrank as a share of the now-618ms step. Without it the decoder relevance gate is firing on stale numbers.
ranked.prereqs: Run AFTER decoder TILE_M 128->64 (#30) lands if that lands first (so the re-profile reflects the final tile geometry), OR run BEFORE #30 to decide whether #30 is even worth a cycle. Recommended: run before #30 — it is gate-free and tells you if B1 is still a real share. Independent of the mamba lane.

The only caveats: (a) the coarse slot[2] B1 number is atomicMax-of-slowest-CTA, so it is the slowest-CTA wait, correct for the grid-barrier wall model but read as such; (b) the --fwd-fine buckets only instrument INSIDE the cp.async ring (the dW path never TICs; Ledger:296-297), so the fp32 inter-GEMM epilogue passes remain in the coarse P1 remainder — do not expect --fwd-fine to isolate the P1-epilogue target. This is a measurement, not a build; its risk is mis-reading, not mis-computing.

ranked.title: Decoder P1 fp32 inter-GEMM epilogue fusion (fold bias/round/residual into the GEMM out() lambda) — BUILD ONLY AFTER a new coarse clock64 slot confirms the foldable-pass share; the foldable subset is a MINORITY of the 24-26% uninstrumented P1 residual
ranked.change_summary: Fold the cleanly-removable fp32 epilogue passes into the GEMM accessor lambda in model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh. The 3-lens verdict refuted this on the bottleneck/mechanism lenses because the foldable subset is SMALL and UNMEASURED, but it survived parity and is NOT a dead-well (it hits a real 24-26% slice, unlike the <1% P3 tail). The genuinely-removable subset (verified per call site): the standalone in_b qkv bias add (:1534-1538, the one true bit-CHANGER — currently double-rounds bf(bf2f(f2bf(gemm))+in_b); folding to f2bf(v_fp32+in_b) MOVES TOWARD the pinned oracle bf(x@bf(w)^T+in_b), an absorbable-direction sub-bf16-ULP change), and the ff0 pre-fold (:1569-1577, uses dectc_gemm_fwd_f32 so sc.work holds the EXACT fp32 accumulator -> byte-identical). The out_proj/ff2 residual sweeps (:1554-1557/:1585-1588) keep the residual add (only the bias term relocates) and the immediately-following LN re-reads sc.work from HBM regardless — so folding saves only one write+read + barriers, NOT the consumer read. NON-foldable (stays as separate passes): attention (:1541), the two LayerNorms (:1560,:1592), gelu (:1576), and the MANDATORY bf16 dW-operand casts X_ctx/X_x1/X_gact (:1543,:1561,:1572-77) which the P2 dW GEMM consumes as HBM operands (:2186-2190). bwd is the same shape (:1839-1891). HARD PREREQ: a new byte-identical coarse clock64 slot must isolate the foldable-pass time from the attention/LN/cast work BEFORE building.
ranked.gate_recipe: fast_triage screen: build with the fold ON vs OFF; the OFF build must be byte-identical PTX (the fold is #if-gated). Run the cheap better/worse signal at d=2048/B=16384, 1 seed, to confirm not-worse before spending the full gate. fp64+A/A/A gate: the FULL fp64 oracle + A/A/A across 11 decoder cells x seeds {42,7,123}. CRITICAL parity watch: the qkv-bias fold changes shipping bits (single-round vs double-round) — confirm it lands within the 1e-4 fp32-reorder tol AND passes A/A/A bit-determinism (the eliminated round is a sub-bf16-ULP perturbation, but the gate is the arbiter, cf. the IL=4 reject + ViT-dW gate-RED where CPU-clean-by-construction was necessary-not-sufficient). The ff0/residual folds must preserve the fp32-through-residual order (NO early round before the residual add) — verify per :1554-1557/:1585-1588. 3-seed timing: KEEP iff faster on 3+ seeds AND parity-clean at d=2048/B=16384, else REVERT. PRE-BUILD GATE: do not author until the new coarse clock64 slot shows the foldable subset is above the relevance floor (per the re-profile, rank 2).
ranked.projected_step_delta: UNCERTAIN / likely small. The foldable subset is a minority of the 24-26% uninstrumented P1 residual (most of that residual is attention + 2 LN + gelu + mandatory casts, none touchable). Realistic upside is folding ~2 of ~6 fwd sweeps + their barriers -> low single-digit % of the now-618ms step at best. The lever's own estimate (shared with the bwd twin) was ~0.06-0.08x combined fwd+bwd, and that is UNMEASURED. Rank it BELOW the diagnostics that size it.
ranked.prereqs: Strict ordering: (1) decoder re-profile (rank 2) confirms fwd/dX is still a dominant share at 618ms; (2) a NEW coarse clock64 slot isolates the foldable-pass time within P1; (3) only then build. Lands after ViT-B1/TILE_M. The bwd-residual twin (dec_p1_dx_residual_fold) is the same lever's other half — 3 of its 4 dY-bf16 writes are ALREADY fused (:1841,:1853,:1872) so its addressable surface is even smaller; co-author with the fwd half if the share justifies it, do NOT gate separately.
ranked.risk: MEDIUM. (a) Bottleneck risk: the foldable share is unmeasured and structurally a minority — high chance of a NEUTRAL gate (P3-style sub-measurable, though hitting a bigger phase). (b) Parity risk: the qkv-bias fold is a real bit-change vs shipping (single vs double round); must clear the 1e-4 tol + A/A/A — absorbable-direction but gate-arbitrated. (c) The out_proj/ff2 residual fold is only legal if fp32-through-residual order is preserved; an early round fails the gate. Net: only worth a ratchet cycle if rank-2 + the new slot show the foldable share clears the floor.

ranked.title: Cross-K-step wgmma software pipeline via wait_group<1> on the fwd/dX ring — DEFER pending the rank-2 re-profile; the same-accumulator RAW chain blocks the claimed cross-K MMA overlap and the per-K wait_group<0> doubles as the slot-WAR fence
ranked.change_summary: Relax the per-K-step wgmma_wait_group<0> to wait_group<1> in the baked PIPE=1/STAGES=4 fwd/dX else-branch (model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:1043-1062, drain at :1055) to overlap MMA of K-step k with issue of k+1. The 3-lens verdict REFUTED this on all three lenses, and the refutation is structural, not just relevance: (1) MECHANISM-FATAL: every wgmma overload declares the fp32 accumulator '+f' inout and issue_k accumulates IN PLACE into the SAME acc[ai].c[] each K-step (:759-760, k=0 ScaleD=0 overwrite / k>0 D=A_k*B_k+D) — a serial RAW chain across K. wait_group<1> only un-blocks the cheap async ISSUE of k+1; it does NOT let the MMA of k overlap the MMA of k+1, because the in-place accumulate forbids exactly that. The legal overlap already exists ACROSS the kIL=2 independent M-atom fragments (:726-727,755-761), which the ledger credits as the captured tensor-pipe overlap (Ledger:712-713). (2) PARITY-FATAL: the per-K wait_group<0> is the load-bearing WAR fence — the STAGES=4 refill targets slot (k-1)%RS whose WAR-safety EXPLICITLY relies on 'drained via wgmma_wait_group<0> in iter k-1' (:1026-1037). Relaxing to <1> defers that drain by one iter -> stage_k_async writes slot (k-1)%RS while wgmma k-1 may still be reading it -> live-slot WAR clobber -> nondeterministic accumulator -> gate-RED. (3) BOTTLENECK: the impact estimate multiplies the PRE-ring 56.5% phase x PRE-ring WGMMA 31%/20% against the POST-ring 618ms baseline — both factors stale-high; no post-ring re-profile exists.
ranked.gate_recipe: DO NOT BUILD as specified. If a future cycle revisits it, the ONLY legal form couples wait_group<1> to a DEEPER ring (refills landing >=2 slots behind the in-flight wgmma) so the WAR fence is preserved — a larger lever than the advertised 'depth knob, no new smem'. fast_triage: would need a deeper-ring variant build (smem-budget re-check at 1 CTA/SM under the dynamic cap). fp64+A/A/A gate: would be gate-RED-by-construction at the current ring depth (live-slot WAR race); only gateable once the slot-WAR invariant is re-proven at the deeper depth. 3-seed timing: irrelevant until the WAR hazard is resolved AND the rank-2 re-profile shows WGMMA (not WAIT) is the post-ring dominant in-ring bucket — which the +1.49x deeper-ring KEEP (which attacked the WAIT) makes unlikely.
ranked.projected_step_delta: ~0 / likely NEUTRAL even if made WAR-safe. The first-order overlap is already captured by kIL=2 across independent fragments; the residual is the genuine accumulate-chain latency a group-wait depth cannot hide. The targeted WGMMA bucket (31%/20%) is the MINORITY in-ring slice; the WAIT drain (43%/56%) was the real lever and is already owned by the deeper ring KEEP.
ranked.prereqs: Blocked behind the rank-2 re-profile (must show WGMMA is the dominant post-ring in-ring bucket — improbable) AND a deeper-ring redesign to preserve the slot-WAR fence. Decoder-only (ViT wgmma is ~3% of step, B1-bound). Effectively bottom of the decoder queue.
ranked.risk: HIGH. As specified it is a live-slot WAR data race -> nondeterministic output -> A/A/A gate-RED by construction (not a tunable margin — the refill targets exactly the slot whose wgmma is deferred). Even made safe via a deeper ring, the upside is a minority slice already overlapped by kIL=2 -> likely NEUTRAL, paying a real redesign cost. The related PIPE=2 producer/consumer engine LOST its gate (857 vs 618ms). List, do not pursue near-term.

dead_wells: vit_dw_fwd_ring_noport: NOT a lever — a do-not-pursue assessment confirming the two decoder KEEPs (dW contiguous-staging + fwd/dX cp.async-ring) do NOT port to ViT. The ViT dW twin is already REVERTED (Ledger:80-105: even after the 2-line IMA fix it gave only +4.5% AND went fp64+A/A/A gate-RED on supergrok2/vit, because ViT dW is 3% of step, Ledger:149). The fwd-ring port is dropped pre-emptively: the ViT engine (model_stage_vit_tc.cuh:397-401) is FULLY UNPIPELINED with no kRingAsync to deepen, so porting drags in the entire ring + grid-cooperative transpose pre-pass (the exact large surface that produced the dW-twin IMA) against a NON-bottleneck (ViT prize is the B1 51% non-GEMM surface). Wrong-bottleneck per the META-LESSON. WATCH: do not accidentally restart the dW twin (its scaffold is now IMA-clean); its supergrok2/vit gate-RED was never root-caused (deferred), so any future ViT GEMM-staging path sharing that machinery inherits a latent hard-gate hazard.

vit_p1_ln_rowparallel: REFUTED 3/3. (bottleneck) LN share within P1 is ASSERTED not measured; the closest measured analogue — the head-CE per-sample reduction using the IDENTICAL row-serial vit_block_sum/max 3-barrier pattern — measured ~0.4% (PERF_ANALYSIS:60,69) and was refuted-by-measurement. (mechanism) Wrong reduction axis: the LN reduce is over kD=128 (not the d=2048 bench batch-scale), so a 128-wide whole-block reduce is shuffle-dominated, not a 6.5k-barrier storm; and B1 sub-tiling (#29) DISSOLVES the P1 wall by redistributing work across the 116 idle CTAs WITHOUT touching LN. (parity) The warp-per-row map is a DIFFERENT fp32 reduction tree over the d-axis -> reassociates -> needs-parity-fp32-reassoc; ViT parity is demonstrably fragile (dW twin gate-RED all 3 seeds). Gated behind unbuilt #29 + its own unbuilt FINE P1 sub-profiler.

vit_p1_epilogue_fuse: REFUTED on bottleneck/mechanism (parity survives). Code premise TRUE (model_stage_vit_tc.cuh:894-948: 4 GEMMs each + a __syncthreads-gated HBM RMW of sc.work; 15 syncthreads/fwd-tile) but the share FAILS dominance: the authoritative ViT profile (Ledger:149-158) is B1_barrier 51.2% DOMINANT, P1_bwd 23.7%, P1_fwd 21.7%, P2_dW 3.0%; the lever sums P1_fwd+P1_bwd=45% and mislabels THAT (lumped GEMM+attn+LN+epilogue) as the epilogue. B1 waits on the SLOWEST CTA so speeding the average CTA's epilogue does little until B1 is fixed (#29). Same class as the +4.5% dW twin. Prereq (B1 sub-tiling) DISSOLVES the target. Build only if a FINE P1 sub-profiler (not yet built) isolates the epilogue share AFTER #29 lands.

vit_attn_inline_smem: REFUTED 3/3. (bottleneck) Attention is the THIRD/smallest of three P1 sub-components (LN/elementwise/attn) behind the 51% B1 barrier; share UNMEASURED (no attn sub-timer exists — only the 6-slot coarse g_vit_prof + 2-slot head sub-timer). Quantitative premises wrong: real config is kHeads=4 (not 32), kSeq=17, kD=128 (not H=32/d=2048), and attn weights live in per-CTA HBM tile scratch, not a global tensor — overstating traffic ~8x. (mechanism) Wrong surface (B1 imbalance, not P1 HBM); STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE fwd->bwd smem caching (the megakernel runs ALL-fwd then a grid barrier then ALL-bwd, so sc.attn[li] MUST be [kLayers]-indexed HBM — smem does not survive the grid sync); occupancy-break risk (smem-resident attn weights bust the 48KB/1-CTA-per-SM budget, the deeper-ring failure mode). (parity) The fwd ctx 'round-trip' is ALREADY fused (:904-908 downcasts to bf16 X_ctx, a load-bearing dW operand). Dead-well guarded by the relevance gate.

vit_head_ce_deadwell: CONFIRMED dead-well (self-refuting, correct). Head+CE run only on B CLS rows (1 of kSeq=17 positions) over a 97-wide vocab (vit_layout.cuh:52 keeps kVocab=97 at d=2048) — structurally ~1/17 of the per-row surface. MEASURED ~0.4% at d=128 (PERF_ANALYSIS:60,69), and the 2026-06-17 d=2048 profile (Ledger:149-158) has no head-CE line (sub-1% remainder). Disposition: read the existing g_vit_prof_head[0..1] counters on the SG_VIT_PROFILE build to formally retire stale queue entry VIT_TC_001 — NO kernel edit (parity-noop). Do not pursue a fusion.

dec_attn_scalar_cost: CONFIRMED dead-well 3/3. Decoder attention is scalar fp32 CUDA-core work but FLOP-trivial: kSeq=SG_DEC_SEQ=4 (NOT 8 as the lever claimed — dec_weights.cuh:107, decoder_layout.cuh:43), so attention/linear ratio = S/d = 4/2048 ~ 0.2% (half the lever's already-tiny estimate). The 56.5% fwd/dX phase is already attributed to cp.async DRAIN (WAIT 43%/56%) by the --fwd-fine profiler, leaving no room for scalar attention. Only the parity-safe load-vectorize attacks ~0.2% (sub-noise); the tempting softmax/dscores batching reassociates the ascending-k fp32 sum -> fails the hard gate. Mark dead unless seq grows.

sub_s3_n256_dead: CONFIRMED dead-well (register-physics). wgmma.cuh:317 kRegs=N/2 -> N=256 needs 128 accum regs/thread (+64 over N=128). REPORT.md:39-41: all kernels pinned at 255 regs x 256 threads = 65,280 = the FULL 64K SM file, occupancy exactly 1 CTA/SM zero-margin; SAM cells already spill ~15KB at N=128. The persistent grid-barrier HARD-REQUIRES >=1 CTA/SM (fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh:314-318 static-assert; same 'too many resources' failure that killed P0 depth-3/4 Ledger:52 and the S>=3 ring Ledger:112). Best case spills to net-zero (mirrors the m-major-coalescing revert SCOPING:270-272); likeliest won't launch. TILE_N at a measured optimum (128->64 = +51% slower, Ledger:39). PARITY NOTE: the math is parity-CLEAN (N is the output-column dim, orthogonal to the ascending-k reduction) — the parity-risky label is misframed; the fatal blocker is LAUNCH/OCCUPANCY, not numerics. Dead everywhere (substrate-wide 255-reg pin).

sub_s1_swizzle_deferred: REFUTED on bottleneck/mechanism (parity classification is honest). 128B smem swizzle on the wgmma A/B operand tiles. NO profiler counter isolates wgmma-operand-read bank conflicts (the fine WGMMA bucket lumps issue+commit+wait_group<0>, decoder_tc.cuh:290; grep-confirmed no shared_ld_bank_conflicts evidence on the wgmma path). The dominant cost is the cp.async WAIT drain (43%/56%, already owned by the deeper-ring KEEP), not the read-conflict sliver inside the minority WGMMA bucket (31%/20%). Geometry largely defeats it (K=16 bf16 tiles = 16B/K-row, not the all-rows-same-bank pathology 128B swizzle fixes). High rewrite surface: the descriptor BUILDERS (make_desc_*_kmajor, wgmma.cuh:274-288) hardcode the INTERLEAVE LBO/SBO for all swizzle modes + the staging scatter must physically permute — flipping only the descriptor bits 63:62 makes wgmma read the WRONG matrix (the ViT-dW IMA class). PARITY-RISKY (Ledger: NONE is the only gate-validated layout; 128B needs a from-scratch fp64+A/A/A re-gate). DEFER behind an ncu shared_ld_bank_conflicts measurement; do not build before it shows non-trivial conflicts, and even then it ranks below the wgmma-pipeline + P1-fusion levers.

sub_p1_fp32_epilogue_fuse: REFUTED (the cross-model/substrate-wide framing of the decoder P1-epilogue lever). On the decoder it is the SAME lever as rank-3 (dec_p1_epilogue_fuse_measured) — kept ranked, gated on measurement. The substrate-wide/ViT-twin framing is dead per the META-LESSON: ViT is B1-imbalance-bound (51%, dW 3%), so porting the epilogue fuse to ViT is the same mis-port that gave the dW twin +4.5%+gate-RED. The qkv-bias double-round vs single-round is bit-DIVERGENT-by-construction (gate-arbitrated), the residual fold's coalescing regresses (out() fires in wgmma fragment-scatter order vs the coalesced separate pass), and most of the ~10 syncthreads are non-removable LN/attn/cast barriers. Decoder-only and measurement-gated = rank 3; the ViT/substrate generalization = dead.

mb_workspace_wall_outputstationary: REFUTED 3/3 as a current actionable lever (the WALL is statically REAL — fused_mamba_megakernel.cuh:514 nCTA*kMambaTotalElems carve, :603 per-CTA FULL-grad partial, :649 ascending-CTA reduce; 14.4GB at d=1024, 792GB at 1.5B). But it contributes 0% to every measured step phase (an allocation enabler, not a step-time lever), has NO profiler evidence (mamba profiler unwired — rank 1), and the ENABLER and the PARITY VIOLATION are the SAME change: output-stationary dW converts the per-sample kSeq=8 reduce -> full-T K-contraction, which CHANGES the fp32 accumulation order -> needs-parity-fp32-reassoc, GPU-only-revalidatable, likely outside the 1e-4 tol (Ledger:134-135 DEFER). Worse, the M0 scaffold converts only 5 of the per-layer weights (x_proj/dt_proj/SSM/embed/scan grads STAY per-CTA), so it shrinks the converted slice, not 'collapses the wall'.
